settings.description: SS11.10 - the alpha-mode row of the 21-byte compact tier, re-measured after SS11.3 found the alpha channel badly starved. The first pass held the alpha AC count at the shipped 5 and was therefore measuring the wrong question. Alpha mode spends 9 extra prefix bits, so the opaque compact layouts do not fit: the same coefficient counts cost 25 bytes. Budget is 161-168 bits = 54 prefix + 9 alpha DC/scale + L*lb + 2*C*cb + A*ab.
